lessons.title: Lesson 1: Characters and Plots in Fairy Tales
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Lesson 1: Characters and Plots in Fairy Tales.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK Lớp 5.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn.

concepts.definition: Used to describe completed actions in the past. Regular verbs add -ed (played, lived); irregular verbs change form (go -> went, see -> saw, have -> had).
concepts.example: Yesterday, Mai read the story of Mai An Tiem. He was very brave and hardworking.
concepts.essence: Key tense for narrating stories, folktales, and personal memories.

concepts.definition: Describing personality in stories: clever (thông minh), greedy (tham lam), kind (tốt bụng), hard-working (chăm chỉ), gentle (dịu dàng).
concepts.example: What is Mai An Tiem like? - He is hard-working and clever.
concepts.essence: Essential vocabulary for reading comprehension questions.

rules.statement: Structure of question 'What is he/she like?'
rules.meaning: Asks about personality and character traits, NOT physical looks. (Contrast with 'What does he look like?' for appearance).
rules.example: 'What is the fox like?' - 'It is clever and greedy.'

workedExamples.prompt: Change the verbs into past tense to complete the sentence: 'Last Sunday, Phong (visit) ... his grandparents and (eat) ... delicious watermelons.'
steps: Bước 1: Động từ 'visit' là động từ có quy tắc => thêm -ed thành 'visited'.
Bước 2: Động từ 'eat' là động từ bất quy tắc => chuyển thành 'ate'.
Bước 3: Viết lại: 'Last Sunday, Phong visited his grandparents and ate delicious watermelons.'

commonMistakes.mistake: Adding -ed to irregular verbs like 'eated' or 'goed'.
commonMistakes.why: Irregular verbs have special past forms: eat -> ate; go -> went; see -> saw; buy -> bought.
